items.title: File Einspruch against the Einkommensteuerbescheid 2025
items.quote: Frist: ein Monat nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: The letter states it was 'zur Post gegeben am 30.03.2026', so this posting date (not the printed Bescheiddatum of 26.03.2026) starts the delivery fiction. This is a Finanzamt, and posting is after 1 Jan 2025, so the 4-day delivery rule (§122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO) applies: 30.03.2026 + 4 days = 03.04.2026 (a Friday) = deemed delivery day; it is not a Saturday, Sunday or holiday, so no shift under §108 Abs.3 AO is needed here. The one-month Einspruch period (§355 Abs.1 AO) then runs from 03.04.2026 to the same-numbered day one month later: 03.05.2026. That day is a Sunday, so under §108 Abs.3 AO the period end moves to the next working day, Monday 04.05.2026, which is not a public holiday in NW.
